request.description:
**Endpoint:** POST [http://localhost:8080/api/disputes](http://localhost:8080/api/disputes)

**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{customerToken}} (whoever is the customer in this job)  
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

**Body (form-data):**

transactionId: {{transactionId}}  
reasonCategory: WORK_INCOMPLETE  
description: The plumber didn't fix the leak properly. Water is still dripping.  
evidenceFiles: \[Select 2-3 image files\] (photos are optional)

**Response:**

{  
"disputeId": 8,  
"transactionId": 13,  
"status": "OPEN",  
"openedAt": "2026-01-02T20:27:13.2569516",  
"resolvedAt": null,  
"evidencePhotos": \[  
{  
"photoId": 4,  
"photoUrl": "uploads/disputes/file_0_960c93cb-f72f-4b2b-b285-241c54c3b7e4.jpg",  
"uploadedAt": "2026-01-02T20:27:13.3666266"  
}  
\]  
}

---

Body (form-data):  
transactionId: {{transactionId}}  
reasonCategory: WORK_POOR_QUALITY  
description: Bad work quality.  
evidenceFiles: \[Select 6 image files - exceeds limit of 5\]EndFragment

**Expected Response:**

{  
"status": 400,  
"message": "Max 5 evidence photos allowed",  
"timestamp": "2026-01-02T21:19:51.6100769",  
"errors": null  
}

---

You can only open a dispute if the transaction is past the complete stage (complete, confirmed, paid)

So trying to open a dispute for a transaction that is still in the earlier status, you get this response,

{  
"status": 400,  
"message": "Only completed, confirmed or paid transactions can be disputed",  
"timestamp": "2026-01-02T21:34:49.9833743",  
"errors": null  
}

---

Duplicate Dispute:

{  
"status": 409,  
"message": "Transaction already has a dispute",  
"timestamp": "2026-01-02T21:37:55.9942299",  
"errors": null  
}

**Unauthorized Access**  
GET [http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/my-disputes](http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/my-disputes)

**Headers:** Authorization: no token

**Expected Response:**

{  
"timestamp": "2026-01-02T19:59:01.311+00:00",  
"status": 401,  
"error": "Unauthorized",  
"path": "/api/disputes/my-disputes"  
}

GET [http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/{{disputeId}}](http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/{{disputeId}}`)

**Get Other User's Dispute:**  
GET [http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/{{disputeId}}](http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/{{disputeId}})  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{otherCustomerToken}} // Different customer

**Expected Response:**

403 Forbidden
